# mojo-toml
> Native TOML 1.0 parser and writer for Mojo with zero Python runtime dependencies.
## Project Summary
mojo-toml provides parsing and writing support for TOML configuration files in Mojo.
The library targets TOML 1.0 compliance and includes partial TOML 1.1 support.
## Core Features
- TOML 1.0 parser support, including nested tables, dotted keys, arrays, and inline tables.
- TOML writer support with semantic round-trip fidelity.
- Validation for duplicates and malformed structures with line and column error context.
- Support for additional numeric bases (`0x`, `0o`, `0b`) and selected TOML 1.1 escapes.

## Install Guidance
- Recommended packaging and release consumption is documented in the home page and user guide pages.
- For source-based consumption, use the repository and include `src` in Mojo include paths.
